rubric.preregistration_status: Same visible-landform rules as v2, before corrected v3 candidate image assessment; exploratory correction, not an independent preregistration
rubric.support: 80 km context with centered 20 km study footprint; observations restricted to landforms resolved at 500 m or coarser

requirements.rule: A laterally extensive, comparatively smooth floor-like unit is visible in or adjoining the 20 km footprint. Brightness alone cannot establish flatness or a basin origin.
An organized ridge, scarp or mass-defined margin is visible within 80 km context. It need not share an impact or depositional origin with the target.
The scene resolves the spatial transition between the floor-like unit and the margin; an isolated smooth patch with no interpretable context is insufficient.

rubric.gates: Every mandatory requirement must be supported in both Earth and target imagery; missing/obscured features remain unassessable. A positive model assessment is a provisional remote-sensing interpretation, not independent validation.
excluded_inferences: numeric slope from single optical image
novelty from absence of a web hit

sampling: 28 retained comparisons; 8 unfilled slots; not a population accuracy estimate
